note: Deck recipes (BRAND-SYSTEM.md §8). A recipe lists slide ids from a content file and assigns one pairing per section. lib/recipe.js builds any length from the same content; lib/ocean.js checks the rules on save.

rules.coverMatchesClose: The close uses the cover's pairing and background, whatever pairing the cover uses.
rules.closeIsLogoOnly: The close shows the vertical logo and nothing else.
rules.sectionPairing: Every content slide in a section uses that section's pairing; adjacent sections never share one.
rules.dividerPairing: A divider reverses its section's pairing, or uses a pairing that shares one of its colours (for example Sprig + Sage for a Sprig + Cedar section). It sits on that field's environment background unless a photo is supplied under the image SOP.
rules.noticeSlide: Investor decks add a disclaimer slide immediately before the close. It does not count toward the recipe length.
rules.pairingTiers: Content slides use text or large tiers only. Display pairings (Sage + Sprig, Sprig + Crimson, Citron + Honeydew, Cedar + Olive) carry 44 pt type and up on dividers, pull quotes and key moments. Tonal pairings carry no text.
